Because computers and telecommunications are legally banned in parliament

questions.question: Why does a democracy provide better room to correct its own policy mistakes than an autocracy?
options: The Supreme Court automatically removes prime ministers every Sunday
Government policies are erased automatically after six months
All laws require unanimous consent of every adult citizen
Decisions are open to public debate and scrutiny, and ruling parties can be voted out if they refuse to rectify errors
questions.explanation: Democracy allows room to correct mistakes because mistakes cannot be hidden for long. There is a space for public discussion on these mistakes and room for correction; either rulers have to change their decisions or rulers themselves can be changed.

questions.question: What is the primary dilemma educators and political scientists observe when assessing democracy?
options: Democracy is practiced everywhere but has no written constitution
Democracy is seen as good in principle, but felt to be not so good in its actual practice
Democracy requires all citizens to serve in active combat forces
Democracy bans newspapers and independent investigative journalism
questions.explanation: Our fascination with democracy often pushes us into taking a position that democracy can address all socio-economic and political problems. We face a dilemma: democracy is seen to be good in principle, but felt to be not so good in its practice.
